title: Palisades (Holtec restart): External_Sender Holtec Determination of no Significant Hazards Consideration [['E-Mail']]

documents.text:
From:            JOHN LaFORGE
To:              Marlayna Doell
Subject:         [External_Sender] Holtec determination of no significant hazards consideration
Date:            Thursday, October 8, 2026 5:16:31 PM


Comment to: Marlayna.Doell@nrc.gov

Marlayna Doell
NRC

Re
Comments on the proposed determination of no significant hazards consideration may be (1)
telephoned to Marlayna Doell, Project Manager, Operating Reactor Licensing Branch 3, at
301-415-3178, (2) e-mailed to Marlayna.Doell@nrc.gov, or (3) submitted in writing to the
Office of Nuclear Material Safety and Safeguards, Mail Stop: TWFN-5-A85, U.S. Nuclear
Regulatory Commission, Washington, DC 20555-0001, ATTN: Guidance and Publications
Branch. All comments must be received by 4:15 p.m. Eastern Time (ET) on October 8, 2026.

Deaer Marlayna Doell,.

I object that the NRC provides only a 44 hour window to make a comment on this
matter.

The link at the NRC webpage notice of public notice is in tiny print and nearly illegible
format.

It appears that the Public is being railroaded into creating the appearance of ability to
Comment, when in all practicality, Public Comment will be a farce.

Real public notice is lacking and this process is a railroad. Additional time is needed
to allow experts to be heard.


Thank you
JOHN LaFORGE
